_doc: Chart style for #178 (docs/m2-view-briefs.md section 4). Points are UI points; colours are palette names from ui_concept.C. Drawn live by the client.

zero_line.when: the value range crosses 0; label it 0 in bold

axis_label.money: short form: 950, 12.5k, 3.2M, 1.1B, minus sign for negatives

single_point: draw chart_dot alone at its value, no line
